t: Niat & Bismillah. Niatkan wudhu dalam hati, lalu ucapkan Bismillah.
Membasuh Kedua Telapak Tangan. Basuh kedua telapak tangan sampai ke sela-sela jari.
Berkumur. Masukkan air ke mulut, kumur-kumur, lalu buang airnya.
Membersihkan Hidung. Hirup sedikit air ke hidung pelan-pelan, lalu keluarkan.
Membasuh Wajah. Basuh seluruh wajah, dari dahi sampai dagu dan dari telinga ke telinga.
Membasuh Tangan sampai Siku. Basuh tangan kanan sampai siku, lalu tangan kiri.
Mengusap Kepala. Basahi tangan, lalu usap sebagian kepala.

Membasuh Kaki sampai Mata Kaki. Basuh kaki kanan sampai mata kaki, lalu kaki kiri.
Doa Setelah Wudhu. Selesai wudhu, angkat tangan dan baca doa.

Intention & Bismillah. Make the intention for wudu in your heart, then say Bismillah.
Wash Both Hands. Wash both hands, between the fingers too.
Rinse mouth. Put water in your mouth, swish it around, then spit it out.
Clean the Nose. Gently sniff a little water into your nose, then blow it out.
Wash the Face. Wash your whole face, from forehead to chin and ear to ear.
Wash the Arms to the Elbows. Wash your right arm up to the elbow, then your left.
Wipe the Head. Wet your hands, then wipe over your head.
Clean the Ears. Wipe the inside and back of both ears.
Wash the Feet to the Ankles. Wash your right foot up to the ankle, then your left.
Du'a After Wudu. After wudu, raise your hands and say the du'a.

Assalamu'alaikum! Let's do some gardening with Ais!
Hehe!
Alhamdulillah! Masya Allah!
Alhamdulillah. Ayo coba lagi!
Tunggu Pantulannya! Bola merah itu besar dan pelan. Tunggu bola memantul sekali di depan Kakak, baru pukul! Ketuk tombol PUKUL saat bola sudah memantul dan sampai di dekat Kak Adam.

Backhand Dua Tangan. Sekarang backhand! Kalau bola datang ke sisi tanpa tangan raket, pegang raket dengan dua tangan, putar badan, lalu ayun! Semua bola datang ke kanan layar. Ketuk BACKHAND saat bola sampai di dekat Kak Adam.

Forehand & Backhand. Kalau bola datang ke sisi tangan raket, pakai forehand. Kalau ke sisi satunya, pakai backhand dua tangan — kedua tangan memegang raket supaya kuat! Kak Adam menghadap kamu. Bola ke kiri layar? Forehand. Ke kanan layar? Backhand.

Voli di Net. Sekarang Kakak berdiri dekat net. Voli artinya memukul bola sebelum memantul! Raket di depan wajah seperti tanda STOP, lalu pukul pendek seperti meninju — jangan ayun besar. Jangan tunggu memantul! Ketuk VOLI saat bola terbang sampai di depan Kak Adam — sebelum memantul! Mulai sisi forehand, lalu backhand, lalu campur.

Kaki Lincah. Bola oranye lebih cepat! Lihat tanda lingkaran tempat bola akan mendarat, lalu geser kakimu ke sana sebelum bola sampai. Ketuk Kiri, Tengah, atau Kanan untuk menggeser Kak Adam ke arah bola.
Servis Roket. Setiap poin dimulai dengan servis. Lempar bola ke atas, lalu pukul saat bola di titik paling tinggi! Ketuk SERVIS saat bola ada di zona hijau, paling atas.

Pertandingan Pertama. Waktunya bertanding melawan Raka! Kamu melihat dari sisi Raka. Kembalikan setiap bola dengan forehand atau backhand. Menangkan satu game. Skor tenis: Love (0), 15, 30, 40, lalu Game!
Forehand dua tangan: lebih kuat dan stabil!
Forehand satu tangan: jangkauan lebih panjang!
Acak: gaya forehand Kak Adam ganti-ganti!
Alhamdulillah! Masha Allah!
Alhamdulillah. Let's try again!
Wait for the Bounce! The red ball is big and slow. Wait for it to bounce once in front of me, then hit! Tap HIT once the ball has bounced and reached Kak Adam.

Two-Handed Backhand. Now the backhand! When the ball comes to the side without my racket hand, hold the racket with both hands, turn, and swing! Every ball comes to the right of the screen. Tap BACKHAND when the ball reaches Kak Adam.

Forehand & Backhand. If the ball comes to my racket-hand side, use a forehand. If it comes to the other side, use a two-handed backhand — both hands on the racket for power! Kak Adam is facing you. Ball on the left of the screen? Forehand. On the right? Backhand.

Net Volley. Now I stand close to the net. A volley means hitting the ball before it bounces! Hold the racket in front of your face like a STOP sign, then punch it short — no big swing. Don't wait for the bounce! Tap VOLLEY when the flying ball reaches the front of Kak Adam — before it bounces! First the forehand side, then the backhand side, then mixed.
Quick Feet. The orange ball is faster! Look for the circle where the ball will land, then move your feet there before it arrives. Tap Left, Middle or Right to move Kak Adam to the ball.
Rocket Serve. Every point starts with a serve. Toss the ball up, then hit it at the very highest point! Tap SERVE when the ball is in the green zone, right at the top.
First Match. Time for a match against Raka! You're watching from Raka's side. Return every ball with a forehand or backhand. Win one game. Tennis scoring: Love (0), 15, 30, 40, then Game!
Two-handed forehand: strong and steady!
One-handed forehand: longer reach!
Mix: Kak Adam switches his forehand style!

Kucing Kecil Kedinginan.
Malam itu hujan turun pelan-pelan.
Baby Mo melihat seekor kucing kecil menggigil di teras.
Ia mengambil handuk lembut dan menyelimutinya sambil berbisik, "Bismillah, kamu aman sekarang."
Kucing kecil itu mendengkur hangat, dan Baby Mo tersenyum senang.
Bintang yang Malu.
Di langit ada bintang kecil yang malu untuk bersinar.
Bulan berkata lembut, "Cahayamu kecil, tapi tetap indah."
Bintang kecil pun mencoba bersinar, sedikit demi sedikit.
Dari jendela, Baby Mo berbisik, "MasyaAllah, cantik sekali!" lalu menutup mata.
Tiga Butir Kurma.
Sore itu Baby Mo punya tiga butir kurma manis.
Adiknya memandang dengan mata berbinar.
Baby Mo memberikan satu kurma sambil tersenyum.
"Berbagi membuat hati hangat," kata Bunda, dan Baby Mo tidur dengan hati senang.
Kata Maaf.
Siang tadi Baby Mo tidak sengaja menjatuhkan menara balok temannya.
Temannya jadi sedih.
Baby Mo berkata, "Maaf ya, ayo kita bangun lagi bersama."
Menara barunya malah lebih tinggi! Sebelum tidur, Baby Mo bersyukur punya teman yang baik.

t: Tanaman Kecil.
Baby Mo menanam sebutir biji di dalam pot.
Setiap pagi ia menyiramnya dengan sabar.
Hari ini muncul daun hijau yang mungil!
"SubhanAllah, tumbuh!" serunya gembira. Malam ini ia bermimpi tentang kebun penuh bunga.
Menolong Nenek.
Nenek membawa belanjaan yang berat.
Baby Mo berlari kecil dan membantu membawa kantong yang ringan.
Nenek tersenyum, "JazakAllah khairan, cucuku."
Hati Baby Mo terasa hangat seperti selimut, dan ia tidur dengan senyum.
Bulan Menemani.
Lampu kamar sudah redup.
Baby Mo melihat bulan bulat di luar jendela.
"Bulan, kamu tidak tidur?" tanyanya, dan cahaya bulan terasa lembut.
Baby Mo membaca doa tidur, lalu terlelap dengan tenang.
Semut yang Rajin.
Di taman, Baby Mo melihat barisan semut kecil.
Mereka membawa remah roti bersama-sama, saling menolong.
"Kalau bekerja sama, yang berat jadi ringan," pikir Baby Mo.
Malam ini ia berjanji membantu Bunda merapikan mainan besok.

Squeeze the toothpaste — just a pea-sized blob.

The Cold Little Kitten.
That night the rain fell softly.
Baby Mo saw a little kitten shivering on the porch.
He fetched a soft towel, wrapped it gently and whispered, "Bismillah, you are safe now."
The kitten purred, warm and cosy, and Baby Mo smiled.
The Shy Little Star.
High in the sky lived a little star who was too shy to shine.
The moon said gently, "Your light is small, but it is lovely."
So the little star tried to shine, a tiny bit at a time.
From his window Baby Mo whispered, "MasyaAllah, how pretty!" and closed his eyes.
Three Sweet Dates.
That afternoon Baby Mo had three sweet dates.
His little sister looked at them with shining eyes.
Baby Mo gave her one, with a big smile.
"Sharing makes hearts warm," said Mum, and Baby Mo went to sleep feeling happy.
The Sorry Word.
Today Baby Mo knocked over his friend's block tower by accident.
His friend felt sad.
Baby Mo said, "I'm sorry. Let's build it again together."
The new tower was even taller! At bedtime Baby Mo was thankful for his kind friend.

t: The Little Plant.
Baby Mo planted one tiny seed in a pot.
Every morning he watered it patiently.
Today a teeny green leaf popped up!
"SubhanAllah, it's growing!" he cheered. Tonight he dreams of a garden full of flowers.
Helping Grandma.
Grandma was carrying heavy shopping.
Baby Mo trotted over and carried a light bag for her.
Grandma smiled, "JazakAllah khairan, my dear."
Baby Mo's heart felt warm like a blanket, and he fell asleep smiling.
The Moon Keeps Watch.
The bedroom light was low.
Baby Mo saw a round moon outside the window.
"Moon, aren't you sleepy?" he asked, and the moonlight felt soft and gentle.
Baby Mo said his bedtime du'a and drifted off peacefully.
The Busy Ants.
In the garden Baby Mo saw a line of tiny ants.
